rows.text: stores `01CB2498` at qword `[rcx]`; when dword `rcx+8` is non-zero, calls the function at `00793410` + 0x3C with qword `rcx+0x10` if that qword is non-null and bit 31 of the dword is clear, then stores qword 0 at `+0x10` and dword 0 at `+8`; it then makes the same check once more on the current fields, calling the function at `00793410` + 0x5E with qword `+0x10` when bit 31 of dword `+8` is clear and the qword is non-null, and again stores 0 in both fields

notes: Both release calls go to the same callee; cited by site because the host excerpt does not name it. The second check can only call when dword +8 was 0 on entry (the first block zeroes both fields otherwise).
